name: term-images
description: Lets Claude render D2 diagrams locally and show them, and images, as real pictures inline in the terminal

maxColumns.title: Max picture width
maxColumns.description: Widest a picture is drawn, in terminal columns (1-255)

maxRows.title: Max picture height
maxRows.description: Tallest a picture is drawn, in terminal rows (1-255); taller pictures are scaled down

cellAspect.title: Cell height / width
cellAspect.description: Height of a terminal cell divided by its width; raise it if pictures look stretched vertically

autoAllow.title: Allow without asking
autoAllow.description: Run show_diagram and show_image without a permission prompt (an explicit deny rule still wins)
